Upon his arrival, An Yun immediately caught the attention of the top boss, Qin Zhilu, making the other Protectors so jealous that the number of people who wanted to kill him could form a long line.
Rumors spread that he was the pampered canary kept by their boss, a rumor that An Yun himself started to believe. To survive, he worked hard every day to act coquettish, although his attempts were somewhat stiff.
Qin Zhilu glanced at him and said, “Seems obedient on the surface.”
Yet he couldn’t resist reaching out to pat his head.
In the Canary’s first battle, the Protectors placed bets at the beginning, betting on his certain death. Living up to their expectations, he was severely damaged, but at the brink of death, he burst forth with a sliver of vitality and turned the tables!

[An Yun: If you like time so much, you might as well fall into an eternal time loop.] 
[The AI’s consciousness has awakened, and a large number of humans have been captured.] 
[An Yun: Retrieve the AI and train it again.] 
[A book began to circulate in the Main City, and all Protectors have fallen to it.] 
[An Yun: Such foolish mind control tactics, I…] 
[The book is titled “God An Yun’s Fantastical Abilities.”] 
[An Yun: …What is that?] 
[It’s the observations and summaries of you by the Protectors. They have all joined God An Yun’s Church.] 
[An Yun: …] 
Thank you, he didn’t even know he had those abilities.
From beginning to end, his only goal was to hug the Commander’s thighs and save his own skin.

99222.synopsis:
Zhao Wu transmigrated into the world of Great Qin, originally wanting to be a prodigal young master, marrying a few beautiful wives and concubines, living a carefree and happy life.
Unexpectedly, the Great Dao Golden List appeared out of nowhere.
Those who are listed on the Golden List will all receive rewards from the Great Dao.
The first time, the Divine Sword List, first place, the Divine Dragon Sword; second place, the Peerless Good Sword…
Ying Zheng: “What? My Heavenly Question didn’t make the top ten? The holders of the top ten are all Martial Gods?”
The second time, the Military Unit List, first place, the Undying Divine Soldiers, second place, the Invisible Ghost Soldiers…
Meng Tian: “How is it possible? My Golden Fire Cavalry didn’t make the top ten? Not a single unit of the empire made the top ten?”
The third time, the Incomparable Beauty List, first place, Yan Ling Ji, second place, Xue Nu, third place…
The fourth time, the Assassin List, first place, Yan Fei, second place, Jing Ni, third place…
“My heavens, the top ten on the Incomparable Beauty List are actually the top ten on the Assassin List, using beauty to kill?”
As the lists were announced one by one, Zhao Wu’s identity as the Martial God could no longer be hidden!

***
The newly crowned First Emperor of Qin, Ying Zheng, finds his ambitious plans for an eternal empire challenged by the appearance of the One That Escaped and its lists. As swordsmen and strategists alike scramble to claim a spot on the “Divine Sword List,” the world is introduced to the enigmatic Martial God, a figure seemingly capable of wielding all the power the lists offer. However, while the world is focused on the Martial God, Zhao Wu, a seemingly lazy and hedonistic young man, is revealed to be at the heart of the changes, not only possessing several of the highest-ranked swords, but also a hidden connection to the Martial God.
As the lists continue to appear, revealing not only swords, but also military units, and even the potential for immortality, the world descends into a frenzy of ambition and conflict. Zhao Wu, surrounded by powerful allies and peerless beauties, finds himself unwillingly thrust into the center of this maelstrom. While others scheme for power and immortality, Zhao Wu is content with a life of leisure, but the world insists on changing around him.
From the halls of the Qin Imperial Court to the secret lairs of the Hundred Schools of Thought, the appearance of the lists ignites a firestorm of ambition, revealing hidden agendas and long-forgotten grudges. The world is forced to grapple with new realities and face the possibility that the old order is about to be completely overturned. Can Ying Zheng maintain his hold on power? Can Zhao Wu avoid the responsibility that the lists have thrust upon him? And what is the true nature of the One That Escaped, this force that can seemingly rewrite fate itself?

102038.synopsis:
SS-Rank Esper Nakyoo Seong and His Guide’s Struggle in a World Without Guides
One day, SS-rank Esper Nakyoo Seong and his guide, Ji Seon Woo, are suddenly pulled into a mysterious portal, transporting them to an unfamiliar world. There, they are taken in by a man named Jayan, who pleads with them to save a future world devoid of guides.
Nakyoo Seong, focused solely on returning to his own time with his guide, refuses outright. However, Ji Seon Woo, in contrast, accepts the request to save the world.
“What makes you think we should stay here? We don’t even know what they’ll demand from us!
Wake up! We’ve been kidnapped—we’re the victims here!”
“I know that! But what if we leave without a plan? What then? What if it’s even more dangerous out there? What if we have nowhere to eat or sleep?”
Ultimately, unable to defy the bond with his marked guide, Nakyoo Seong begrudgingly stays in Seubel. However, trouble quickly follows—people around them won’t stop flirting with Ji Seon Woo, an unexpected fated partner appears, and to top it off, Song Yeo Hwan, who was delayed in his dimensional transfer, finally joins them. Now, Nakyoo Seong has a throbbing headache—and possibly an ulcer.

[“Popular, aren’t we, young master? I’m good at this too, you know. If you’re going to have fun, why not include me?”] 
“Both of you, shut up and get lost.”
With no interest in anyone except Ji Seon Woo, Nakyoo Seong does everything he can to return to the present day. But in this warped future, will he truly make it back home unscathed?

103318.synopsis:
Before meeting the senior brother, I woke up hungry every day, opened my eyes and started writing my will, writing 60 letters a month T^T
Character setup: Easy to take care of, a big contrast in personality, but a “starving ghost” bottom and a very loving, muscular, gentle “daddy” top, who is also a “human chef” expert.
—
After a rebellious act that angered many, young master Zhu Yu was sent to study abroad in the UK, with his living expenses strictly controlled.
In this unfamiliar land, Zhu Yu couldn’t cook, so he had to rely on the school cafeteria for meals, but British food obviously didn’t suit his taste, as he had grown up in China. 
As a result, in just three months, Zhu Yu lost more than 10 kilograms. In order to satisfy his cravings, he started following a food blogger on a letter-based platform for cooking tutorials.
One day, a new neighbor moved into the apartment. That evening, Zhu Yu clicked on the blogger’s live stream as usual and saw the blogger making braised chicken with rice.
At the same time, the aroma of the chicken drifted into his room, and the cat snoring beside him followed the scent and ran out.
Zhu Yu ran outside and found that the scent was coming from his new neighbor’s house. He could only sniff the aroma, but the cat suddenly started scratching the neighbor’s door, meowing loudly.
Zhu Yu was so scared that he knelt down to hug the cat, but the door opened.
The person who opened the door was a man in an apron, looking handsome with a triangular physique and well-developed chest muscles. The smell of yellow braised chicken filled the air, and Zhu Yu nearly fainted from the fragrance.
When he saw the mole on the man’s hand and the style of his apron, Zhu Yu thought: ?
Isn’t this the food blogger I’ve been following?
With tears in his eyes, Zhu Yu lifted the cat in his arms, sobbing, “Please, give us some food! We can do anything!!”
The cat also teared up, meowing. 
Bai Chen: … Could you get up first?
Later, Bai Chen recalled that he had never seen someone so hungry… along with a cat.
A simple bowl of braised chicken rice, with the person crying while eating, and the cat meowing while eating…
—
During the two years he took a break from school due to psychological issues, Bai Chen taught himself how to cook and started posting food tutorials online. Over time, he developed a desire to feed others.
He buried this feeling deep inside.
Until the third day of his return to school, a beautiful young man with pink hair knocked on his door…
From then on, this desire was greatly satisfied.
Small Theater 1:
After realizing that Zhu Yu was his fan, Bai Chen found his preferences on Zhu Yu’s account.
Later—
“Zhu Yu, I have a chef’s certificate, and I can cook all sorts of dishes for you. My dad is a rich businessman, and I’m his only heir. You don’t need to work outside. I have my own villa, and after marriage, you can sleep until three in the afternoon. I’m healthy, have no bad habits, and I work out every week. Here’s my health check report. You don’t even have to honor your in-laws…” 
After saying this, Bai Chen played a voice message from his mom. 
“He doesn’t need to honor his in-laws! If he really minds, we can go wander the streets,” his mom said.
Bai Chen then continued, “So, will you date me?”
Zhu Yu’s red-braised pork dropped from his mouth: “Huh?”
Small Theater 2:
The two argued over a small matter.
Bai Chen made pastries to reconcile with Zhu Yu.
Zhu Yu angrily asked, “Why are you here?”
Bai Chen: “Apologize.”
Zhu Yu: “Sorry. Now, can I have the pastries?”
Bai Chen: ?

…

107670.synopsis:
Lea, who was executed after committing every imaginable atrocity.
Having returned to the past, she vows that in this life, she will live for him alone.
If it were for atonement, she was willing to offer up everything she had.
Money, status, her guiding ability. Even her most intimate secret…
***
As she reached her breaking point, memories from the vanished past to the present flashed rapidly through her mind.
The guilt and anguish she had been suppressing burst forth like a dam breaking.
“I’m sorry. Truly, I was wrong.”
She begged him without even knowing exactly why he was angry.
“For what?”
Even as she wept pitifully like a child, Calix didn’t bat an eye.
Instead, the mouth that had been tightly shut slowly relaxed.
“E-Everything.”
She felt overwhelming remorse toward him. For everything… including the fact that she had come back to life.
“No, Lea.”
Calix denied her words as he slowly closed the distance.
His movements were cautious, like a predator driving its prey into a corner.
“Your real sin…”
He reached her at last, and with an expressionless face, extended his hand slowly.
The moment his hand brushed her trembling, rounded shoulder, he pulled her into his arms.
“…is that you kept your true identity hidden all this time.”
Only after Lea was in his embrace did he let out a languid laugh, and in a voice filled with possessiveness and ecstasy, he whispered,
“How dare you be so insolent. You were mine from the very beginning.”
As he stroked her fox ears with his fingertips, his gaze darkened, fixed on the pendant of the collar she wore.
The pendant that marked him as the owner of this fox.
